name: idle-craft
description: A free idle crafting and adventure game. No ads, no paywalls, no tracking.

scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:web && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && npx cap sync android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#2b2118' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#2b2118' --splashBackgroundColor '#2b2118' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#2b2118' && node scripts/android-patch.js
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:prepare && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
